# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c35 P3](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P45](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c25 P11](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0011), [v3 c34 P11](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril Lisle is a handsome and well-dressed young man. He has striking dark eyes and dark hair, and is known for a charming, dark, velvety smile.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c27 P0](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0000)_

## Personality

Cyril is refined, artistic, and romantic, often writing poetry and expressing his sentiments in elevated language. He is capable of being attentive and polite, but lacks a strong sense of humor and can be somewhat superficial.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P21](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0021), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c27 P0](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0000), [v3 c27 P4](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0004), [v3 c35 P4](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- Romantic  <sub>[v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012)</sub>
- Polite  <sub>[v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c35 P2](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0002)</sub>

- Writing poetry  <sub>[v3 c27 P0](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To win the love of Nell Harcourt and marry her  <sub>[v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012)</sub>

## History

Cyril Lisle returned to Wexcombe College as a Junior after spending two years in Europe caring for his mother. Upon his return, he met Nell Harcourt in the park during a rainstorm and began courting her, sending her flowers and poetry. During their Senior year, his mother and sisters visited Nell at Tabby's Place. Towards the end of their final term, he proposed to Nell in a pavilion near the harbor. When Nell rejected his proposal, realizing she did not truly love him, Cyril was deeply hurt and declared he would never love another woman. By the following summer, however, he had married another woman and was living happily.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P45](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0045), [v3 c27 P0](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0000), [v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c38 P45](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0045)_

- He took a break from his college studies for two years to travel in Europe with his mother while she was ill.  <sub>[v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c25 P45](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0045)</sub>
